structured_output.summary: Added an optional `pickups?: boolean[]` to RaceStageOptions (src/ui/stages/stage.ts). raceStage spreads `...(o.pickups && { pickups: o.pickups })` into the RaceView it syncs, so views without the option are unchanged. src/ui/stages/pickups.stage.ts now makes one call, raceStage(root, { ..., at: AT, pickups: [true, false, true] }). It no longer calls stageTrack() a second time, rebuilds cars with carOnTrack, or syncs a second copied view, and the unused stageTrack/carOnTrack imports are gone. The stage now renders in one sync with no in-between state lacking the POWER-UP keycap, and its final screen is the same as before. New test tests/ui/race-stage-pickups.test.ts: on a desktop pointer, raceStage with `pickups` shows the legend STEER, GAS, BRAKE, POWER-UP, PAUSE, and without the option STEER, GAS, BRAKE, PAUSE. It failed before the fix (raceStage dropped pickups) and passes after. pnpm typecheck is clean and pnpm test passes (116 files, 753 tests).
